purpose: Define representative benchmark workloads for each discovered engine to enable apples-to-apples comparison when benchmarks are executed

benchmark_protocol.judge: Claude Sonnet 4.6 (main agent) scores quality on 1-5 rubric
benchmark_protocol.environment: macOS 12.7.6 Intel Mac mini, same conditions each run

workloads.name: Single-file bug fix
workloads.description: Given a Python file with 3 intentional bugs (type error, off-by-one, wrong dict key), fix all bugs without breaking other code
workloads.success_criterion: All 3 bugs fixed, tests pass, no regressions

workloads.name: Multi-file feature implementation
workloads.description: Add a new REST endpoint to a Flask app (model, route, tests, docs)
workloads.success_criterion: Endpoint works, test passes, OpenAPI doc updated

workloads.name: Codebase navigation Q&A
workloads.description: Answer 5 factual questions about a 1000-line codebase (function names, logic flow, config values)
workloads.success_criterion: 5/5 correct answers verified against ground truth

workloads.name: Test suite generation
workloads.description: Generate pytest tests for a module with 10 functions — achieve 80%+ coverage
workloads.command_template: claude --print 'Generate comprehensive pytest tests for module.py'
workloads.success_criterion: Coverage >= 80%, tests are syntactically valid

benchmarks.notes: Use claude --print flag for non-interactive mode. Measure wall-clock time with 'time' command. API cost from Anthropic usage dashboard.

workloads.name: Bug-fix workflow on known issue
workloads.description: Run the built-in 'bug-fix' workflow on a seeded bug in a test repo
workloads.command_template: node ~/.openclaw/workspace/antfarm/dist/cli/cli.js workflow run bug-fix 'Fix the NullPointerException in auth.js'
workloads.success_criterion: Workflow completes all steps, bug is fixed in output

workloads.name: Feature development workflow
workloads.description: Run 'feature-dev' workflow to add a simple feature to a test module
workloads.command_template: node ~/.openclaw/workspace/antfarm/dist/cli/cli.js workflow run feature-dev 'Add input validation to user registration'
workloads.success_criterion: Feature implemented, workflow status shows complete

workloads.name: Security audit workflow
workloads.description: Run 'security-audit' on a test codebase with 3 seeded OWASP vulnerabilities
workloads.command_template: node ~/.openclaw/workspace/antfarm/dist/cli/cli.js workflow run security-audit 'Audit the auth module for security issues'
workloads.success_criterion: All 3 vulnerabilities identified in output

workloads.name: Workflow status check latency
workloads.description: Measure time from workflow run to first status update in SQLite
workloads.success_criterion: Status reflects current step within 30s

benchmarks.notes: Antfarm self-advances via cron jobs. Measure total wall-clock from 'workflow run' to 'workflow status = complete'. Verify SQLite entries are created correctly.

benchmarks.blocker: Python venv not created; pip dependencies not installed

workloads.name: Self-improving skill creation
workloads.description: Give Hermes a novel task (summarize a PDF), then check if it creates a reusable skill
workloads.command_template: python3 run_agent.py --task 'Summarize this PDF and save summary to file' --non-interactive
workloads.success_criterion: Task completed AND new skill created in skills/ directory

workloads.name: Multi-provider model routing
workloads.description: Run same task with openrouter, anthropic, and openai backends; compare output quality and cost
workloads.success_criterion: Task completes on all 3 providers, outputs comparable

workloads.name: Telegram remote task
workloads.description: Send task via Telegram, verify Hermes picks it up and completes it remotely
workloads.success_criterion: Task completes and response arrives in Telegram within 5min

workloads.name: Mini-SWE benchmark run
workloads.description: Run mini_swe_runner.py on 5 SWE-bench lite instances
workloads.success_criterion: >= 2/5 resolved correctly

benchmarks.notes: Run AFTER venv setup. Use batch_runner.py for non-interactive benchmarks. Hermes skill creation should be verified by checking skills/ dir before and after each run.

workloads.name: Code generation from spec
workloads.description: Generate a complete Python class (BankAccount with deposit/withdraw/balance) from a natural language spec
workloads.command_template: codex 'Write a Python BankAccount class with deposit, withdraw, balance methods and proper error handling'
workloads.success_criterion: Class is syntactically valid, all methods present, error handling correct

workloads.name: Shell command generation
workloads.description: Generate a bash one-liner for a non-trivial task (find all Python files modified in last 7 days, count lines)
workloads.command_template: codex 'Give me a bash command to find all .py files modified in last 7 days and count their total lines'
workloads.success_criterion: Command is correct, executable, produces right result

workloads.name: Code explanation
workloads.description: Explain a 50-line obfuscated Python function — identify purpose, inputs, outputs, side effects
workloads.success_criterion: All 4 elements (purpose, inputs, outputs, side effects) correctly identified

benchmarks.notes: Requires OPENAI_API_KEY in environment. Use non-interactive mode flags. Compare vs Claude Code on same tasks for head-to-head quality diff.

benchmarks.blocker: n8n not currently running — start with: ~/.npm-global/bin/n8n start

workloads.name: HTTP webhook to Telegram notification
workloads.description: Create a workflow: POST /webhook → format message → send Telegram notification. Trigger 10 times, measure delivery rate
workloads.success_criterion: 10/10 webhooks result in Telegram messages within 5s

workloads.name: Scheduled API poll + data transformation
workloads.description: Every 1 minute: fetch Kalshi market list, filter active markets, write to JSON file
workloads.command_template: via n8n UI — Cron + HTTP Request + Code + Write File nodes
workloads.success_criterion: File updated correctly on each 1-minute tick for 10 cycles

workloads.name: AI node integration (GPT-4o mini)
workloads.description: Workflow: receive text input → AI node summarizes → output to file
workloads.command_template: via n8n UI — Manual Trigger + OpenAI node + Write File
workloads.success_criterion: Summary generated, saved, quality >= 3/5

benchmarks.notes: Start n8n first: ~/.npm-global/bin/n8n start (or add to PM2). UI at http://127.0.0.1:5678. Has existing database — import/export workflows as JSON for reproducible benchmarks.

workloads.name: Sub-agent spawn latency
workloads.description: Measure time from sub-agent spawn request to first tool call in sub-agent
workloads.success_criterion: Sub-agent starts within 10s

workloads.name: Telegram command round-trip
workloads.description: Send command via Telegram, measure time to response delivery
workloads.success_criterion: Response delivered within 30s

workloads.name: Parallel sub-agent execution
workloads.description: Spawn 3 parallel sub-agents for independent research tasks, measure total time vs sequential
workloads.success_criterion: Parallel completes in <1.5x time of single agent

workloads.name: Approval-gated workflow
workloads.description: Submit an action requiring approval, measure time from submission to execution after Telegram approval
workloads.success_criterion: Action executes correctly after approval, rejected if not approved within 60s

benchmarks.notes: Production system — benchmarks should be run in non-production window. Focus on latency and reliability metrics. Cost governance via oe-proxy means actual API costs lower than raw Anthropic rates.

workloads.name: Draft email generation (qwen2.5:3b)
workloads.description: Generate a professional follow-up email from a brief prompt
workloads.command_template: ollama run qwen2.5:3b 'Write a professional follow-up email to a client who hasn't responded in 3 days'
workloads.success_criterion: Email is professional, coherent, on-topic, quality >= 3/5

workloads.name: Classification task (tinyllama)
workloads.description: Classify 20 strings as positive/negative/neutral sentiment
workloads.success_criterion: >= 75% accuracy vs ground truth labels

workloads.name: Code explanation (phi3:mini)
workloads.description: Explain a 20-line Python function in plain English
workloads.success_criterion: Explanation is factually correct, quality >= 2/5

workloads.name: Model comparison: qwen2.5:1.5b vs qwen2.5:3b
workloads.description: Run same summarization task on both sizes, compare quality vs latency tradeoff
workloads.success_criterion: Quantify quality delta between 1.5b and 3b vs latency difference

benchmarks.notes: All runs are $0 cost. Intel CPU only — expect 10–30 tokens/sec depending on model. Primary value: zero-cost draft generation and classification. API endpoint: http://localhost:11434/api/generate

phase_1_quick_wins.rationale: Ollama is $0, Codex is fast. Antfarm smoke test.

phase_2_claude_code.rationale: Nav Q&A first (cheap), then bug fix, test gen, feature dev.

phase_3_platform.rationale: OpenClaw latency benchmarks during low-traffic window.

phase_4_n8n.rationale: Requires n8n running — do in dedicated session.

phase_5_hermes.rationale: Requires venv setup first. Most expensive in setup time.
